title: Verification configuration schemas
responsibility: Defines verification setup, runner defaults, capture-index records and benchmark workload formats.

outputs.name: verifyConfigFile
outputs.description: File name `harness.verify.json` for the verify configuration. This module only declares the name; it never reads or writes the file.

outputs.name: verificationsDirectory
outputs.description: Scratch directory `.cache/harness/verifications` that holds verification drafts until they are persisted as Git evidence. This module only declares the path; it never creates or reads the directory.

outputs.name: snapshotsDirectory
outputs.description: Scratch directory `.cache/harness/snapshots` under the same root as the verifications directory, for verification snapshots. This module only declares the path; it never creates or reads the directory.

outputs.name: captureIndex
outputs.description: File name `captures.ndjson` of the capture index, to which each check writes one line in `HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR`; each such line has the shape captureLineSchema defines. This module only declares the name.

outputs.name: verifyConfigSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 Zod schema for the verify configuration (unknown keys are rejected), covering the writing-limit version, the optional performance-required flag, setup, shared links, declared outputs, builds and tools, runner templates, profiles, checks, a positive test timeout and optional capture and record byte caps. Parsing fills defaults for outputs, builds, tools, profiles and checks, expands each check's profile into the check, and rejects an unknown profile, a check with neither its own command nor a profile command, a profile command without {target} that more than one check inherits, or a literal test file in a command that does not match the check's path.

outputs.name: defaultVerifyConfig
outputs.description: The default VerifyConfig: empty setup, link, outputs, builds, tools, profiles and checks lists, the runner templates `bun x vitest run {target}` for vitest and `bun x playwright test {target}` for playwright, and a test timeout of 600000 in `timeouts.test`. Each template's `{target}` is replaced by the test file.

outputs.name: captureLineSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for one captures.ndjson line: it requires `evidence` and `state` ids matching the unit id pattern, a `kind` of screenshot, audio, output, assertions, trace or benchmark, a `file` that is a plain file name inside the evidence directory (letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens only), and a non-empty `mediaType`. It also accepts optional `viewport` (an id), `clip` (a capture region), `provenance` (fixture or actual-capture), `transcript`, `durationSeconds` (positive), `server` (with `buildId` and `revision`) and `note`, and rejects any other key.

outputs.name: reportedMeasurementSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for one benchmark measurement before the run adds its profile and revision: `unit`, `metric`, `unitOfMeasure` and `method` are required non-empty strings, `value` is a required number or null, and `workload` is a required string or null. Optional `callable`, `unavailable`, `target` (a runtime kind), `samples` (a positive integer) and `comparison` are accepted, and unknown keys are stripped rather than rejected.

outputs.name: benchmarkCaptureSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a benchmark capture payload: `measurements` is a required array of reported measurements. Other top-level fields the check adds are stripped by normal Zod parsing rather than kept.

outputs.name: workloadSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 Zod schema for a workload, a request sent repeatedly through a unit's declared execution target: `id` must match the unit id pattern, `request` has a non-empty `operation` and an optional `input`, `rounds` is 1 to 50 and `iterations` is 1 to 100000.
